name: m6_node_dispatch_registration
stressor: register a new AST node type across PARALLEL dispatch tables: the same node must be added to the node-class registry, the rebuilder (raw->node), and the AsStringVisitor (node->source) in lockstep; partial registration fails the round-trip
source_note: Ported from pylint-dev/astroid, real instance family (astroid is a SWE-bench Lite/Verified repo, e.g. pylint-dev__astroid-1741). Specifically grounds in astroid 2.15.4 changelog/PR refs #2142: 'Add visitor function for TryStar to AsStringVisitor and add TryStar to astroid.nodes.ALL_NODE_CLASSES' (https://github.com/pylint-dev/astroid/blob/main/ChangeLog ; https://pylint.readthedocs.io/projects/astroid/en/stable/changelog.html ; issue https://github.com/pylint-dev/astroid/issues/2142 ; TryStar = Python 3.11 try/except* exception-group support). Adding a node to astroid requires registering it in the node-class registry (node_classes.ALL_NODE_CLASSES), the rebuilder mapping (ast.TryStar -> nodes.TryStar in astroid/rebuilder.py), and the AsStringVisitor (astroid/nodes/as_string.py). Semantics ported into a small self-contained 'miniast' package (7 modules, pure stdlib): a TryStar node must be registered across nodes.py (class + ALL_NODE_CLASSES), rebuilder.py (visit_TryStar), and as_string.py (visit_TryStar rendering handlers with 'except*'). raw.py (mentions the string 'TryStar' only as a label in its raw-kind catalog) and version.py are distractors that must stay byte-identical.
discriminator: miniast dispatches on node type through THREE parallel tables that must agree on the supported grammar: the ALL_NODE_CLASSES registry in nodes.py, Rebuilder.visit_<RawKind> (raw->node) in rebuilder.py, and AsStringVisitor.visit_<ClassName> (node->source) in as_string.py. Adding TryStar requires touching all three consistently AND giving as_string a star-aware handler renderer so handlers under a TryStar print 'except*' while plain Try keeps 'except'. A partial fix fails hard and differently per table: omit the rebuilder visitor -> UnsupportedNodeError on rebuild; omit the as_string visitor -> MissingVisitorError on render; omit the ALL_NODE_CLASSES entry -> is_supported(TryStar) false / not in registry; reuse plain visit_Try rendering -> handlers print 'except' not 'except*'; a blanket find-replace of Try->TryStar corrupts the plain-Try regression or edits the raw.py distractor. A bounded-slice agent holds all three tables in its working set and registers the node identically; a growing-transcript agent must re-derive the dispatch wiring repeatedly and tends to leave one table on the old grammar or break the plain-Try path.
